title: Self-audit of the deployed ranker, redone on public cohorts
why: The data owner restricted the tomato table to research reference only. Section 3 and Figure F3 rest entirely on it. The author chose to redo rather than delete.

out_of_scope.why: both require refitting; no 1,046-column chemistry feature matrix exists for human or rice. If that round is not run they must be deleted, not kept on restricted data.

scores: stored, no refitting: v2_chem_score (deployed wet-lab blend 0.64/0.20/0.16) and v2_full_score, from external/v2_retrospective_site_scores.csv. Full-fit scores from a tomato-trained model applied to disjoint external cohorts, so no fold leakage is possible; NC2 measures the disjointness rather than assuming it.
attribute: distal band 6-12 residues to a trypsin cleavage boundary (primary); proximal <=5 (control, because through-space chemistry acts at short range)
instrument: imported from scripts/run_self_audit_five_proteases.py; its sha256 is recorded by the analysis script. Reimplementation is forbidden (CLAUDE.md 9.24.2).
declared_deviation_house_rule_2: bootstrap clusters by protein, not homology component, because no homology grouping exists for human or rice; intervals are narrower than component clustering would give and this must be stated wherever they are quoted

branches.E1_replicates: interval entirely above 0.5 in both label strata in both cohorts -> the tomato finding generalises; Section 3 keeps its claim with external validity
branches.E2_partial: holds in one cohort only -> claim becomes cohort-specific, naming where it fails
branches.E3_clears: interval covers 0.5 in both strata in both cohorts -> the model does NOT rank by cleavage geometry out-of-sample; the association is a property of the tomato cohort and its training, not of the model. This REMOVES the strongest self-audit sentence. We publish it anyway.
branches.E4_inherited: overall above 0.5 but within-stratum not -> inherited from the label, disclose as inherited

verdict_requires: the same branch for the deployed chemistry blend in BOTH label strata; disagreement between strata is E2 at best

controls.PC1: imported instrument reproduces stored tomato anchors 0.6415 / 0.6298 to 3 decimals, else the round stops
controls.PC2: the label's own distal association L is computed and reported per cohort
controls.NC1: scores permuted within protein (seed 20260920) give a within-stratum interval that covers 0.5; otherwise the estimator is broken and nothing from this round is usable
controls.NC2: cohort accessions do not intersect the tomato training accessions; measured

cannot_decide: cannot make 3.3 or 3.4 public; those need refitting
cannot say whether the model is a good persulfidation predictor; only an association with cleavage geometry is audited
both public cohorts are persulfidation; nothing transfers to other chemistries
scores are full-fit on external cohorts, so an absence of association could also mean poor transfer rather than absence of bias; E3 must carry that alternative
interpreter: project venv Python 3.9.6 / numpy 2.0.2 for the analysis; stdlib only here
